verses.original: Σκιὰν γὰρ ἔχων ὁ νόμος τῶν μελλόντων ἀγαθῶν οὐκ αὐτὴν τὴν εἰκόνα τῶν πραγμάτων κατ’ ἐνιαυτὸν ταῖς αὐταῖς θυσίαις ἃς προσφέρουσιν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς οὐδέποτε δύναται τοὺς προσερχομένους τελειῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Skian gar echōn ho nomos tōn mellontōn agathōn ouk autēn tēn eikona tōn pragmatōn kat’ eniauton tais autais thysiais has prospherousin eis to diēnekes oudepote dynatai tous proserchomenous teleiōsai
verses.literal: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come not the realities . . . . . . themselves It can never by the same sacrifices offered year after year make perfect those who draw near to worship
verses.literalPt: Visto que a Lei tem a sombra dos bens vindouros, não a mesma imagem das coisas, nunca pode, pelos mesmos sacrifícios que eles oferecem continuamente de ano em ano, fazer perfeitos aos que se chegam a Deus.

verses.original: ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἂν ἐπαύσαντο προσφερόμεναι διὰ τὸ μηδεμίαν ἔχειν ἔτι συνείδησιν ἁμαρτιῶν τοὺς λατρεύοντας ἅπαξ κεκαθαρισμένους
verses.transliteration: epei ouk an epausanto prospheromenai dia to mēdemian echein eti syneidēsin hamartiōn tous latreuontas hapax kekatharismenous
verses.literal: If it could . . . would not the offerings have ceased . . . For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins
verses.literalPt: De outra sorte, não teriam cessado de se oferecer, porque os adoradores, tendo sido uma vez purificados, não teriam tido mais consciência de pecados?

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἐν αὐταῖς ἀνάμνησις ἁμαρτιῶν κατ’ ἐνιαυτόν
verses.transliteration: All’ en autais anamnēsis hamartiōn kat’ eniauton
verses.literal: Instead those sacrifices are an annual . . . reminder of sins
verses.literalPt: Nesses sacrifícios, porém, há recordação de pecados todos os anos;

verses.original: ἀδύνατον γὰρ αἷμα ταύρων καὶ τράγων ἀφαιρεῖν ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: adynaton gar haima taurōn kai tragōn aphairein hamartias
verses.literal: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins
verses.literalPt: pois é impossível que sangue de touros e de bodes tire pecados.

verses.original: Διὸ εἰσερχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον λέγει Θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας Σῶμα δὲ κατηρτίσω μοι
verses.transliteration: Dio eiserchomenos eis ton kosmon legei Thysian kai prosphoran ouk ēthelēsas Sōma de katērtisō moi
verses.literal: Therefore when Christ came into the world He said Sacrifice and offering You did not desire but a body You prepared for Me
verses.literalPt: Por isso, entrando no mundo, diz: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste, mas corpo me formaste;

verses.original: Ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας Οὐκ εὐδόκησας
verses.transliteration: Holokautōmata kai peri hamartias Ouk eudokēsas
verses.literal: In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight
verses.literalPt: não te deleitaste em holocaustos e sacrifícios pelos pecados.

verses.original: Τότε εἶπον Ἰδοὺ ἥκω Ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου γέγραπται περὶ ἐμοῦ Τοῦ ποιῆσαι ὁ Θεός τὸ θέλημά σου
verses.transliteration: Tote eipon Idou hēkō En kephalidi bibliou gegraptai peri emou Tou poiēsai ho Theos to thelēma sou
verses.literal: Then I said Here I am it is written about Me in the scroll I have come to do Your will O God
verses.literalPt: Então, eu disse: Eis aqui venho (No rol do livro está escrito de mim) para fazer, ó Deus, a tua vontade.

verses.original: Ἀνώτερον λέγων ὅτι Θυσίας καὶ προσφορὰς καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ ἠθέλησας οὐδὲ εὐδόκησας αἵτινες κατὰ νόμον προσφέρονται
verses.transliteration: Anōteron legōn hoti Thysias kai prosphoras kai holokautōmata kai peri hamartias ouk ēthelēsas oude eudokēsas haitines kata nomon prospherontai
verses.literal: In the passage above He says Sacrifices and offerings burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire nor did You delight in them although they are offered according to the law
verses.literalPt: Dizendo acima que sacrifícios, e ofertas, e holocaustos, e sacrifícios pelo pecado não quiseste, nem te deleitaste neles (os quais são oferecidos segundo a Lei),

verses.original: τότε εἴρηκεν Ἰδοὺ ἥκω τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημά σου ἀναιρεῖ τὸ πρῶτον ἵνα τὸ δεύτερον στήσῃ
verses.transliteration: tote eirēken Idou hēkō tou poiēsai to thelēma sou anairei to prōton hina to deuteron stēsē
verses.literal: Then He adds Here I am I have come to do Your will He takes away the first to establish the second
verses.literalPt: então, disse: Eis aqui venho para fazer a tua vontade. Tira o primeiro para estabelecer o segundo.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ θελήματι ἡγιασμένοι ἐσμὲν διὰ τῆς προσφορᾶς τοῦ σώματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐφάπαξ
verses.transliteration: en hō thelēmati hēgiasmenoi esmen dia tēs prosphoras tou sōmatos Iēsou Christou ephapax
verses.literal: And by that will we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all
verses.literalPt: Na qual vontade temos sido santificados pela oferta do corpo de Jesus Cristo feita uma vez para sempre.

verses.original: Καὶ πᾶς μὲν ἱερεὺς ἕστηκεν καθ’ ἡμέραν λειτουργῶν καὶ τὰς αὐτὰς πολλάκις προσφέρων θυσίας αἵτινες οὐδέποτε δύνανται περιελεῖν ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: Kai pas men hiereus hestēken kath’ hēmeran leitourgōn kai tas autas pollakis prospherōn thysias haitines oudepote dynantai perielein hamartias
verses.literal: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices which can never take away sins
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, todo sacerdote se apresenta, dia após dia, ministrando e oferecendo muitas vezes os mesmos sacrifícios, os quais nunca podem tirar pecados;

verses.original: οὗτος δὲ μίαν ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν προσενέγκας θυσίαν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos de mian hyper hamartiōn prosenenkas thysian eis to diēnekes ekathisen en dexia tou Theou
verses.literal: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins He sat down at the right hand of God
verses.literalPt: mas este, havendo oferecido, para sempre, um só sacrifício pelos pecados, sentou-se à destra de Deus,

verses.original: τὸ λοιπὸν ἐκδεχόμενος ἕως τεθῶσιν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: to loipon ekdechomenos heōs tethōsin hoi echthroi autou hypopodion tōn podōn autou
verses.literal: Since that time He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet
verses.literalPt: daí em diante esperando até que os seus inimigos sejam postos por escabelo dos seus pés.

verses.original: μιᾷ γὰρ προσφορᾷ τετελείωκεν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς τοὺς ἁγιαζομένους
verses.transliteration: mia gar prosphora teteleiōken eis to diēnekes tous hagiazomenous
verses.literal: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified
verses.literalPt: Pois, com uma só oferta, tem aperfeiçoado para sempre aos que são santificados.

verses.original: Μαρτυρεῖ δὲ ἡμῖν καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον μετὰ γὰρ τὸ εἰρηκέναι
verses.transliteration: Martyrei de hēmin kai to Pneuma to Hagion meta gar to eirēkenai
verses.literal: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this First He says
verses.literalPt: O Espírito Santo também nos testifica, porque, depois de haver dito:

verses.original: Αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας λέγει Κύριος διδοὺς νόμους μου ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Hautē hē diathēkē hēn diathēsomai pros autous meta tas hēmeras ekeinas legei Kyrios didous nomous mou epi kardias autōn kai epi tēn dianoian autōn epigrapsō autous
verses.literal: This is the covenant I will make with them after those days declares the Lord I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds
verses.literalPt: Esta é a aliança que farei com eles, depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Imprimindo as minhas leis nos seus corações, eu as escreverei sobre a mente deles, acrescenta:

verses.original: Καὶ Τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθήσομαι ἔτι
verses.transliteration: Kai Tōn hamartiōn autōn kai tōn anomiōn autōn ou mē mnēsthēsomai eti
verses.literal: Then He adds Their sins and - lawless acts I will remember no . . . more
verses.literalPt: Dos seus pecados e das suas iniquidades não me lembrarei mais.

verses.original: Ὅπου δὲ ἄφεσις τούτων οὐκέτι προσφορὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: Hopou de aphesis toutōn ouketi prosphora peri hamartias
verses.literal: And where these have been forgiven an offering for sin is no longer needed
verses.literalPt: Ora, onde há remissão destes, não há mais oferta pelo pecado.

verses.original: Ἔχοντες οὖν ἀδελφοί παρρησίαν εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ αἵματι Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Echontes oun adelphoi parrēsian eis tēn eisodon tōn hagiōn en tō haimati Iēsou
verses.literal: Therefore brothers since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Portanto, irmãos, tendo confiança de entrarmos no Santo Lugar pelo sangue de Jesus,

verses.original: ἣν ἐνεκαίνισεν ἡμῖν ὁδὸν πρόσφατον καὶ ζῶσαν διὰ τοῦ καταπετάσματος τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hēn enekainisen hēmin hodon prosphaton kai zōsan dia tou katapetasmatos tout’ estin tēs sarkos autou
verses.literal: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain - of His body
verses.literalPt: pelo caminho que nos inaugurou, caminho novo e de vida, pelo véu, isto é, pela sua carne,

verses.original: καὶ ἱερέα μέγαν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hierea megan epi ton oikon tou Theou
verses.literal: and since we have a great priest over the house of God
verses.literalPt: e tendo um grande sacerdote sobre a casa de Deus,

verses.original: προσερχώμεθα μετὰ ἀληθινῆς καρδίας ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πίστεως ῥεραντισμένοι τὰς καρδίας ἀπὸ συνειδήσεως πονηρᾶς καὶ λελουσμένοι τὸ σῶμα ὕδατι καθαρῷ
verses.transliteration: proserchōmetha meta alēthinēs kardias en plērophoria pisteōs rherantismenoi tas kardias apo syneidēseōs ponēras kai lelousmenoi to sōma hydati katharō
verses.literal: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water
verses.literalPt: cheguemo-nos, com coração sincero, em plena certeza da fé, tendo os nossos corações purificados de uma consciência má e lavados os nossos corpos com água pura;

verses.original: Κατέχωμεν τὴν ὁμολογίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἀκλινῆ πιστὸς γὰρ ὁ ἐπαγγειλάμενος
verses.transliteration: Katechōmen tēn homologian tēs elpidos aklinē pistos gar ho epangeilamenos
verses.literal: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess for He who promised is faithful
verses.literalPt: firmes, guardemos inabalável a confissão da nossa esperança, porque fiel é o que fez a promessa,

verses.original: καὶ κατανοῶμεν ἀλλήλους εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀγάπης καὶ καλῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: kai katanoōmen allēlous eis paroxysmon agapēs kai kalōn ergōn
verses.literal: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds
verses.literalPt: e consideremo-nos uns aos outros, para nos estimularmos ao amor e às boas obras,

verses.original: μὴ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὴν ἐπισυναγωγὴν ἑαυτῶν καθὼς ἔθος τισίν ἀλλὰ παρακαλοῦντες καὶ τοσούτῳ μᾶλλον ὅσῳ βλέπετε ἐγγίζουσαν τὴν ἡμέραν
verses.transliteration: mē enkataleipontes tēn episynagōgēn heautōn kathōs ethos tisin alla parakalountes kai tosoutō mallon hosō blepete engizousan tēn hēmeran
verses.literal: Let us not neglect meeting together . . . as some have made a habit but let us encourage one another and all the more as you see the Day approaching
verses.literalPt: não abandonando a nossa congregação, como é costume de alguns; mas exortando uns aos outros e tanto mais quanto vedes chegar o Dia.

verses.original: Ἑκουσίως γὰρ ἁμαρτανόντων ἡμῶν μετὰ τὸ λαβεῖν τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκέτι περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπολείπεται θυσία
verses.transliteration: Hekousiōs gar hamartanontōn hēmōn meta to labein tēn epignōsin tēs alētheias ouketi peri hamartiōn apoleipetai thysia
verses.literal: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth no further sacrifice for sins remains
verses.literalPt: Pois, se pecamos voluntariamente, depois de termos recebido o pleno conhecimento da verdade, já não resta mais sacrifício pelos pecados,

verses.original: φοβερὰ δέ τις ἐκδοχὴ κρίσεως καὶ πυρὸς ζῆλος ἐσθίειν μέλλοντος τοὺς ὑπεναντίους
verses.transliteration: phobera de tis ekdochē kriseōs kai pyros zēlos esthiein mellontos tous hypenantious
verses.literal: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries
verses.literalPt: senão uma certa expectação terrível do juízo e um ardor de fogo, que há de devorar os adversários.

verses.original: ἀθετήσας τις νόμον Μωϋσέως χωρὶς οἰκτιρμῶν ἐπὶ δυσὶν ἢ τρισὶν μάρτυσιν ἀποθνήσκει
verses.transliteration: athetēsas tis nomon Mōuseōs chōris oiktirmōn epi dysin ē trisin martysin apothnēskei
verses.literal: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses
verses.literalPt: Aquele que transgride a Lei de Moisés, sendo-lhe provado com duas ou três testemunhas, morre sem misericórdia;

verses.original: πόσῳ δοκεῖτε χείρονος ἀξιωθήσεται τιμωρίας ὁ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καταπατήσας καὶ τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης κοινὸν ἡγησάμενος ἐν ᾧ ἡγιάσθη καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς χάριτος ἐνυβρίσας
verses.transliteration: posō dokeite cheironos axiōthēsetai timōrias ho ton Huion tou Theou katapatēsas kai to haima tēs diathēkēs koinon hēgēsamenos en hō hēgiasthē kai to Pneuma tēs charitos enybrisas
verses.literal: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him and insulted the Spirit of grace
verses.literalPt: de quanto mais severo castigo, pensais vós, será julgado digno aquele que calca aos pés o Filho de Deus e tem em conta de profano o sangue da aliança com que foi santificado, e ultraja ao Espírito da graça?

verses.original: Οἴδαμεν γὰρ τὸν εἰπόντα Ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω καὶ πάλιν Κρινεῖ Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Oidamen gar ton eiponta Emoi ekdikēsis egō antapodōsō kai palin Krinei Kyrios ton laon autou
verses.literal: For we know Him who said Vengeance is Mine I will repay and again The Lord will judge His people
verses.literalPt: Pois conhecemos aquele que disse: Minha é a vingança, eu retribuirei. E outra vez: O Senhor julgará ao seu povo.

verses.original: φοβερὸν τὸ ἐμπεσεῖν εἰς χεῖρας Θεοῦ ζῶντος
verses.transliteration: phoberon to empesein eis cheiras Theou zōntos
verses.literal: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God
verses.literalPt: Horrenda coisa é cair nas mãos do Deus vivo.

verses.original: Ἀναμιμνῄσκεσθε δὲ τὰς πρότερον ἡμέρας ἐν αἷς φωτισθέντες πολλὴν ἄθλησιν ὑπεμείνατε παθημάτων
verses.transliteration: Anamimnēskesthe de tas proteron hēmeras en hais phōtisthentes pollēn athlēsin hypemeinate pathēmatōn
verses.literal: Remember the early days that you were in the light In those days you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos, porém, dos dias anteriores, em que, depois que fostes iluminados, padecestes um grande conflito de sofrimentos;

verses.original: τοῦτο μὲν ὀνειδισμοῖς τε καὶ θλίψεσιν θεατριζόμενοι τοῦτο δὲ κοινωνοὶ τῶν οὕτως ἀναστρεφομένων γενηθέντες
verses.transliteration: touto men oneidismois te kai thlipsesin theatrizomenoi touto de koinōnoi tōn houtōs anastrephomenōn genēthentes
verses.literal: Sometimes . . . you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution at other times you were partners with those who were so treated
verses.literalPt: pois, por um lado, fostes feitos um espetáculo tanto por ludíbrios como por aflições e, por outro, tendes-vos tornado companheiros dos que foram assim tratados.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ τοῖς δεσμίοις συνεπαθήσατε καὶ τὴν ἁρπαγὴν τῶν ὑπαρχόντων ὑμῶν μετὰ χαρᾶς προσεδέξασθε γινώσκοντες ἔχειν ἑαυτοὺς κρείττονα ὕπαρξιν καὶ μένουσαν
verses.transliteration: kai gar tois desmiois synepathēsate kai tēn harpagēn tōn hyparchontōn hymōn meta charas prosedexasthe ginōskontes echein heautous kreittona hyparxin kai menousan
verses.literal: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession
verses.literalPt: Pois não só vos compadecestes dos encarcerados, mas aceitastes, com gozo, o despojo de vossos bens, conhecendo que vós vos tendes a vós mesmos como uma possessão mais excelente e durável.

verses.original: Μὴ ἀποβάλητε οὖν τὴν παρρησίαν ὑμῶν ἥτις ἔχει μεγάλην μισθαποδοσίαν
verses.transliteration: Mē apobalēte oun tēn parrēsian hymōn hētis echei megalēn misthapodosian
verses.literal: So do not throw away your confidence it holds a great reward
verses.literalPt: Não lanceis fora, portanto, a vossa confiança, a qual tem uma grande recompensa.

verses.original: ὑπομονῆς γὰρ ἔχετε χρείαν ἵνα τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ποιήσαντες κομίσησθε τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν
verses.transliteration: hypomonēs gar echete chreian hina to thelēma tou Theou poiēsantes komisēsthe tēn epangelian
verses.literal: You need to persevere so that after you have done the will of God you will receive what He has promised
verses.literalPt: Pois tendes necessidade da perseverança, para que, tendo feito a vontade de Deus, alcanceis a promessa.

verses.original: ἔτι γὰρ Μικρὸν ὅσον ὅσον ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἥξει καὶ οὐ χρονίσει
verses.transliteration: eti gar Mikron hoson hoson ho erchomenos hēxei kai ou chronisei
verses.literal: For In just a little while He who is coming will come and will not delay
verses.literalPt: Pois, ainda em bem pouco tempo, aquele que há de vir virá e não tardará.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ δίκαιός μου ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται καὶ ἐὰν ὑποστείληται οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ho de dikaios mou ek pisteōs zēsetai kai ean hyposteilētai ouk eudokei hē psychē mou en autō
verses.literal: But My righteous one will live by faith and if he shrinks back I . . . . . . will take no pleasure in him
verses.literalPt: Mas o meu justo viverá da fé, e, se ele recuar, nele não tem prazer a minha alma.

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς εἰς ἀπώλειαν ἀλλὰ πίστεως εἰς περιποίησιν ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis de ouk esmen hypostolēs eis apōleian alla pisteōs eis peripoiēsin psychēs
verses.literal: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed but of those who have faith and preserve their souls
verses.literalPt: Mas nós não somos dos que retrocedem para perdição; mas dos que têm a fé para a salvação da alma.
